top_categories.workout_context: 132ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At Sunday Creek Classic, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
9,843ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Sunday Creek Classic. Train it until it feels boring.
Sunday Creek Classic's Gravel roads, Hinterland terrain forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 74 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Sunday Creek Classic's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
Low-cadence force work for 9,843ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.
74 miles on hinterland gravel roads burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
9,843ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Sunday Creek Classic, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Base fitness for Sunday Creek Classic. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Sunday Creek Classic’s 74 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum; adjust for conditions and sweat rate.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Sunday Creek Classic requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on hinterland gravel roads to build confidence. Expect: gravel roads, hinterland terrain, dairy country.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Over Under, and Mixed Climbing to prepare you for 74 miles of hinterland gravel roads in Kenilworth, Queensland.
